useWhen: Run an owner-defined stock-flow model for an Itonami operational question and retain measured assumptions and ledger references.
avoidWhen: Inventing rates or enabling automatic schedules from a model description

inputs.question: bounded operational scenario
inputs.seed: dated observed inputs and missing values

outputs.result: scenario output and target/ledger receipt with assumptions

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
